en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large motor ship at sea. The vessel has multiple masts and cargo gear, with a long white hull and superstructure amidships. Calm water fills the foreground, and partly cloudy sky is in the background. Printed captions appear at the bottom: at left the company name and city, and at right the ship's name, indicating this is a promotional or commemorative postcard of the cargo/passenger ship M/S Meonia operated by The East Asiatic Company Ltd., based in Copenhagen.
